memberdef.name: lowerReturn

briefdescription.para: This hook must be implemented to lower outgoing return values, described by Val, into the specified virtual registers VRegs.

detaileddescription.para: This hook is used by GlobalISel.
FLI is required for sret demotion.
SwiftErrorVReg is non-zero if the function has a swifterror parameter that needs to be implicitly returned.

simplesect.para: True if the lowering succeeds, false otherwise.

memberdef.name: canLowerReturn

briefdescription.para: This hook must be implemented to check whether the return values described by Outs can fit into the return registers.

detaileddescription.para: If false is returned, an sret-demotion is performed.

memberdef.name: lowerFormalArguments

briefdescription.para: This hook must be implemented to lower the incoming (formal) arguments, described by VRegs, for GlobalISel.

detaileddescription.para: Each argument must end up in the related virtual registers described by VRegs. In other words, the first argument should end up in VRegs[0], the second in VRegs[1], and so on. For each argument, there will be one register for each non-aggregate type, as returned by computeValueLLTs. MIRBuilder is set to the proper insertion for the argument lowering. FLI is required for sret demotion.

simplesect.para: True if the lowering succeeded, false otherwise.
